summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute 727 KB obfuscated payload unrelated to advertised feature-gate library
details: The package's declared `preinstall` script executes `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime binary from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ (or reuses a local Bun if present), extracts the platform-specific binary to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it with the bundled `math_init.js` as its argument. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line file wrapped in a rotating string-array obfuscator (a `push/shift` dispatcher over a large mixed hex/string constant table) and is not human-reviewable source. The preinstall also fingerprints the host's C library and distribution (probes `ldd --version` for `musl` and reads `/etc/os-release` for `Alpine`) to select a musl-compatible Bun build. The package's advertised purpose is a React feature-gates library, which does not require a second language runtime, and the obfuscated payload's behavior is not observable from source. The result is that `npm install` of this package causes an obfuscated, non-auditable JavaScript payload to be executed under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
